title: Read Count Table of LY_111 Cohort
author: Xu, Wenjian
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from whole blood using a TRIzol‑based RNA extraction method.

steps.title: Assess RNA integrity
steps.instruction: Measure the RNA integrity number (RIN) of the extracted RNA on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Enrich polyadenylated RNA
steps.instruction: Use the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB, USA) to capture poly‑A‑tailed RNA (mainly mRNA) from the total RNA preparation.

steps.title: Fragment, synthesize cDNA, and build library
steps.instruction: Perform RNA fragmentation, first‑strand and second‑strand cDNA synthesis, and library construction using the NEBNext Ultra™ II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB, USA).

substeps.instruction: Fragment the enriched RNA according to the kit protocol.
Proceed with end‑repair, adaptor ligation, and PCR enrichment as described in the kit.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the prepared libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 and sequence with 150 bp paired‑end reads, generating a minimum of 50 million reads per sample.

steps.title: Clean raw FASTQ files
steps.instruction: Process the raw FASTQ files with fastp version 0.20.0 to remove adapters and low‑quality bases.

steps.title: Align reads to reference genome
steps.instruction: Map the cleaned reads to the GRCh38 GENCODE genome assembly and the Gencode v41 transcriptome using HiSat2 version 2.1.0.

steps.title: Call variants from alignments
steps.instruction: Run the GATK short‑variant discovery pipeline (GATK version 4.1.3.0) together with STAR version 2.5.3 to call SNPs and indels.
